title: 電気回路Ⅰ(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Electric Circuits I
keywords: DC circuits 2.Ohm's law 3.Kirchhoff's law 4.Sinusoids 5.AC basic circuits, Phasors
educationalGoal: This is a fundamental and important subject in the electrical engineering course. To acquire basic knowledge about electrical circuits and develop the ability to conduct analysis and design of electrical circuits through physical and mathematical considerations. First, a case where a circuit having resistors (R) are connected to DC sources is learned, and then a case where a circuit comprising resistors (R), inductors (L), capacitors (C), and combinations thereof are connected to an AC power supply is learned.
advice: The outline of the subjects is as follows. 1.DC circuits: electric circuits and Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's law, superposition principle, Thevenin's Theorem, power and energy. 2.AC basic circuits: sinusoids, phasors relationships for resistors, inductors, and capacitors. AVIS Video Courseware has been prepared for each item in the above, and will be used actively for preparation and review to deepen understanding. This subject is not only "Electrical Circuit II", "Electrical Circuit III", and "Electrical Circuit IV", but also each specialized subject should be studied keeping in mind that it is a special basic course required. Since the progress is adjusted while checking the level of understanding based on the results of a quiz, etc., changes may occur in the class schedule and the content of study.
requiredKnowledge: In this subject, it is important to solve more problems in order to understand and practice the theory. In addition, since they are made one by one, continuous efforts are required on a daily basis. Therefore, we would like you to take actions such as 1) examining various reference books, 2) asking questions to the lecturer, 3) taking advantage of the Mathematical and Science Education Research Center, so that you can definitely clear what you don't understand.

activityGoals.body: Participants can explain Ohm's and Kirchhoff's law in DC circuits, and calculate it using these laws.
Participants can calculate the maximum power condition in the DC circuit.
Participants can calculate the mean and rms value of sinusoids, and analyze combined circuits of R, L and C.
Participants can analyze circuits by the phasors of complex number, and draw graph in each part of the circuit.

achievementLevels.ideal: Participants can explain sufficiently the physical and mathematical implications of Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws. Using the knowledge, they can calculate correctly voltages, currents and energy in the DC circuits. They can calculate the average and effective value of sinusoids, and draw the waveform. they can analyze series and parallel AC circuits composed of R-L, R-C or R-L-C, and calculate correctly the voltage, current and impedance of each part of the circuits.
achievementLevels.standard: Participants can explain the physical and mathematical implications of Ohm's and Kirchhoff's laws. Using the knowledge, they can calculate voltages, currents and energy in the DC circuits. They can calculate the average and effective value of sinusoids, and draw the waveform. they can analyze series and parallel AC circuits composed of R-L, R-C or R-L-C, and calculate the voltage, current and impedance of each part of the circuits.

lessons.content: Circuit elements, Ohm's law, Integrated learning: consideration of familiar electrical products and circuits.
lessons.operation: Lecture, practices, and questions. In principle, subtests are conducted as many times as is appropriate with advance notice. And, the test is explained appropriately.
lessons.assignments: Prepare the contents of the textbook corresponding to the study on the left column. Also, review the matters learned that day. Write the correct answers for the tests. Be sure to submit your report by the deadline. Review the lecture and learn more about Ohm's Law. Study textbooks to understand series and parallel connections of resistors.

lessons.content: Series and parallel connection of resistors
lessons.assignments: Review the lecture and deepen your understanding of the series and parallel connection of resistors. Study textbooks to understand voltage sources, power and energy.

lessons.content: Voltage and current sources, Power and energy

Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of the Kirchhoff's laws. Study textbooks and understand the application of Kirchhoff's laws.
Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of the Kirchhoff's laws.
Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of the Kirchhoff's laws. Study textbooks and understand bridge circuit, voltage divider circuit and shunt circuit.

lessons.assignments: Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of the bridge circuit, voltage divider circuit and shunt circuit. Study textbooks and understand superposition principle and Thevenin's theorem.
Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of superposition principle and Thevenin's theorem.

lessons.assignments: Review the lecture and exercise questions that were not fully answered in the interim exam.

lessons.assignments: Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of the mean value of sinusoid and effective value. Study textbooks and understand circuit equations of sinusoidal AC circuits.

Review the content of the lecture and deepen understanding of the phasor of complex numbers. Study textbooks and understand phasors and impedance of AC circuits.
